responsibility: Defines GCC’s core control-flow graph data structures and inline utilities shared by both GIMPLE and RTL CFG code. It owns the representation of basic blocks, edges, per-IR block payloads (`gimple_bb_info` vs. `rtl_bb_info`), edge and block flag enums sourced from `cfg-flags.def`, profile counts/probabilities on CFG edges, edge iterators, and common helper predicates such as abnormal/fallthrough/EH-edge tests and probability-scaling routines; other CFG construction, analysis, cleanup, loop, and dominance files build on these fundamental types rather than redefining CFG state themselves.
